not_verified: Continuous kinematic sweep not verified: the mechanism is pose-checked at the listed poses only
Teeth are straight tapered teeth without an involute or conjugate flank profile; backlash is generous (~2 mm at mid-cone) by design at the assembled phase

Hand crank cannot complete a full turn: at crank=180 deg the crank grip dips ~4.5 mm into the base plate top (349.8 mm3) and the layshaft/crank arm grazes it (80.0 mm3) — a property of the shipped part geometry

At slip poses that are not multiples of the 22.5 deg side-gear pitch, each bevel mesh grazes ~2 mm3 at the tooth toe (narrow end of the tapered gaps); at full-pitch multiples (e.g. slip=22.5 deg) the mesh is clash-free again
Shafts are not keyed to the side gears; no bushings, thrust washers or separate carrier bearings modelled (carrier locates on the side-gear hub journals in the cheek bores)
No torque, load or bearing-life computation; sized for hand turning only
one_line: A hand-turned open differential demonstrator: straight bevel side gears (16T) and four spider pinions (10T) in a windowed carrier drum, spur ring gear (40T) driven by a layshaft pinion (13T) with a hand crank, hand wheel on each axle. Parametric: revolute mates driven by crank and slip parameters.

specs: Side gears 16T straight bevel, pitch cone half-angle 58 deg, module 3.0 at the outer cone, cone distance 28.3 mm; pinions 10T, pitch cone half-angle 32 deg (atan(10/16), 90 deg shaft angle)
Four pinions on a cross pin (r4.5, Y and Z arms), pinion bores r4.7 (0.2 mm radial clearance)
Ring gear 40T spur, pitch r40 mm, 6 bolts r2.5 into carrier cheek holes r3; input pinion 13T, pitch r13 mm; final-drive ratio 40:13 = 3.08:1
Radial clearances: axle r5.6 / side-gear bore r6 = 0.4 mm; side-gear hub r11 / cheek bore r11.4 = 0.4 mm; layshaft r4 / pedestal bore r4.4 = 0.4 mm; input pinion bore r4.2 / layshaft = 0.2 mm

Bevel teeth are tapered sector gap cuts in tip-cone revolved blanks (thickness tapers with cone distance, gap floors below the root cone); phasing by instance-frame rotations — side gears at half pitch (11.25 deg), input pinion at -6.92 deg

Assembly is parametric: 13 mates (12 revolute + 1 fastened) driven by crank/slip parameters; only the base instance is fixed; saved explode definition 'apart' (ring gear -70 mm X, side gears -/+60 mm X, axles -/+140 mm X, pinions 55 mm radially, layshaft group -45 mm Z)
Base plate 190 x 110 mm; overall 222 mm across hand-wheel grips, 118 mm tall; mass 3.44 kg (steel 7850, cast iron 7200, wood 700 kg/m^3)
